title: Ripped
text: Ripped. Filled the bag up with clothes, picked it up by the handles, and the cloth ripped open on one side.  I had to use duck tape to seal the bag up again.  Very disappointed the in the quality of these bags.  If you buy these, DO NOT pick them up by the handles.
